entries.name: GitHub MCP
entries.popularity_evidence: 32,390★; GitHub's own MCP Registry (https://github.com/mcp/github/github-mcp-server) + Docker Catalog (https://hub.docker.com/mcp/explore) feature it as *the* official GitHub server; PulseMCP all-time 6.9M visitors (weekly figure anomalous, see SUMMARY.md caveat)
entries.auth: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env, OAuth, or GitHub App
entries.annotation_coverage: Partial — title+readOnlyHint always set; destructiveHint on only 2 tools (delete_repository,delete_file); idempotentHint/openWorldHint never set in source but idempotentHint is asserted false on the wire anyway (see Discrepancy 1)
entries.sandboxable: Yes — fine-grained PAT scoped to a disposable repo/org, --read-only flag, --gh-host for a throwaway GHES instance

inclusion.reason: Meets every population criterion (first-party, 32,390 GitHub stars, featured in the official MCP Registry and Docker Catalog, exact Docker image tag recorded). Publicly runnable credential-free via `docker run ... ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server` for DISCOVER, but tool calls need a caller-supplied GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN -- also one of the 3 required stateful sandboxes (disposable repo), so a SandboxManifest template is provided in sandboxes/.

entries.name: Playwright MCP
entries.popularity_evidence: 36,311★; npm @playwright/mcp 4,646,088 dl/week; PulseMCP 5.5M/week, 76.9M all-time — #1 by weekly PulseMCP visits of every server checked; featured in GitHub MCP Registry + Docker Catalog
entries.annotation_coverage: Partial/nonstandard — internal type: 'input'|'assertion'|'action'|'readOnly' field mechanically mapped: readOnlyHint=(type∈{readOnly,assertion}), destructiveHint=!readOnlyHint (blanket negation), openWorldHint hardcoded true for every tool, idempotentHint never emitted
entries.sandboxable: Yes by default (ephemeral/managed profile); but --extension/--cdp-endpoint can attach to the user's real, already-logged-in browser — a documented, non-hypothetical real-session risk

inclusion.reason: Meets every population criterion (36,311 GitHub stars, highest weekly npm downloads of any server checked, corroborated by GitHub MCP Registry + Docker Catalog). No credentials required; publicly runnable via `npx -y @playwright/mcp --headless --isolated`, though DISCOVER may be slow/fail in a minimal container without a pre-provisioned Chromium (attempted, outcome reported, not assumed).

entries.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
entries.popularity_evidence: 49,494★; npm chrome-devtools-mcp 2,074,897 dl/week; PulseMCP 2.3M/week, 45.7M all-time (#2); featured in GitHub MCP Registry
entries.annotation_coverage: Partial, custom scheme — schema is exactly {title?, category(required), readOnlyHint(required), conditions?}; destructiveHint/idempotentHint/openWorldHint do not exist anywhere in this codebase
entries.sandboxable: Yes — --isolated flag (temp profile, auto-cleanup)

inclusion.reason: Meets every population criterion (49,494 GitHub stars, highest star count and #2 weekly PulseMCP visits of any server checked). No credentials required; publicly runnable via `npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp --headless --isolated`, though DISCOVER depends on a usable Chromium in the sandbox (attempted, outcome reported, not assumed).

entries.name: Context7
entries.popularity_evidence: 61,000★ — highest star count of every server checked; npm @upstash/context7-mcp 553,744 dl/week; PulseMCP 1.2M/week, 31.8M all-time; Smithery 5.56k uses; featured in GitHub MCP Registry
entries.transport: stdio (default) or HTTP via one --transport flag; hosted remote at mcp.context7.com/mcp
entries.auth: optional API key either transport; anonymous works at a lower rate limit
entries.annotation_coverage: Full 4-field MCP set on both tools — retrofitted across two releases (v2.0.1, v2.2.2), absent at v2.0.0 launch
entries.sandboxable: Read-only against Context7's own doc index (no customer data) but not offline-testable — always calls live production context7.com/api

inclusion.reason: Meets every population criterion (61,000 GitHub stars, the highest of every server checked). Anonymous access works at a lower rate limit, so DISCOVER is publicly runnable credential-free via `npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp` with no API key.

entries.name: Notion
entries.popularity_evidence: 4,594★; npm @notionhq/notion-mcp-server 137,257 dl/week; PulseMCP 141k/week, 3.4M all-time; listed in Docker Catalog, GitHub MCP Registry, and Claude's connectors directory

entries.name: Slack
entries.popularity_evidence: korotovsky: 1,790★, self-reported "30,000 monthly visitors / 9,000+ users" in its own README; PulseMCP's "official Slack" listing (61.3k/week, 666k all-time) matches the Feb 17 2026 GA date of Slack's closed-source hosted MCP, not the 12★ sample repo it links as "Learn more"
entries.transport: korotovsky: stdio/SSE/HTTP; official: Streamable HTTP + OAuth
entries.auth: korotovsky: bot-token OAuth or "stealth mode" using browser session tokens (xoxc/xoxd) scraped from cookies, bypassing normal workspace app-approval; official: OAuth + admin approval
entries.annotation_coverage: korotovsky: none — 0 grep matches for any of the 4 hints despite running a post-annotations SDK version that supports them
entries.sandboxable: Yes — free workspace + scoped bot + single test channel; message-posting/reactions disabled by default via env-var gate

inclusion.reason: Meets every population criterion (de facto dominant OSS implementation, 1,790 GitHub stars, self-reported adoption, matches the PulseMCP-listed GA date). Requires caller-supplied SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_TEAM_ID; credential-free discovery not attempted for this entry.

entries.name: Serena
entries.popularity_evidence: 28,299★ — 2nd-highest star count checked, ahead of GitHub MCP; PulseMCP 43k/week; featured in GitHub MCP Registry; distributed via PyPI (serena-agent), not just git
entries.annotation_coverage: Partial — title+readOnlyHint+destructiveHint derived from an internal can_edit() marker, not authored against the spec directly; no idempotentHint/openWorldHint
entries.sandboxable: Runs against a local scratch codebase directory — no external account concept

inclusion.reason: Meets every population criterion (28,299 GitHub stars, 2nd-highest of every server checked, featured in the GitHub MCP Registry). No credentials required; publicly runnable via `uvx --from serena-agent serena start-mcp-server` against a scratch directory (glibc Python base image required -- psutil has no prebuilt musllinux wheel, see targets/serena.json).

entries.name: Atlassian (Jira/Confluence)

entries.sandboxable: sooperset: yes — any Cloud site incl. free trial, plus a hard READ_ONLY_MODE env kill-switch

inclusion.reason: Meets every population criterion (5,773 GitHub stars, ~424k PyPI downloads/week extrapolated, corroborated despite the PulseMCP anomaly). Requires caller-supplied JIRA_URL/JIRA_USERNAME/JIRA_API_TOKEN (or CONFLUENCE_* equivalents); credential-free discovery not attempted for this entry.

entries.name: GitLab
entries.popularity_evidence: zereight: 1,907★, 1,403 commits; PulseMCP 43.5k/week vs. official gitlab.com-hosted listing at only 24/week; featured in GitHub MCP Registry
entries.transport: zereight: stdio (default), Docker SSE, streamable HTTP; official: HTTP, part of the user's own GitLab instance
entries.auth: zereight: PAT or OAuth2 (local browser flow or MCP-proxy for remote); official: OAuth 2.0 with Dynamic Client Registration

entries.sandboxable: zereight: yes — free GitLab.com account + scoped PAT, or self-hosted CE

entries.name: Sentry
entries.popularity_evidence: 825★; npm @sentry/mcp-server 94,598 dl/week; listed in Claude's connectors directory; PulseMCP anomalously low (see SUMMARY.md PulseMCP caveat)
entries.transport: hosted remote Streamable HTTP (mcp.sentry.dev/mcp) + local stdio
entries.auth: hosted: OAuth or Authorization: Sentry-Bearer header; stdio: Sentry User Auth Token

entries.sandboxable: Self-hosted Sentry documented (--host, --insecure-http); no explicit SaaS sandbox-org callout

entries.name: Stripe
entries.popularity_evidence: 1,753★ (at old name); npm @stripe/agent-toolkit 16,187 dl/week; PulseMCP 74.5k/week, 1.8M all-time; listed in Docker Catalog, GitHub MCP Registry, Claude connectors directory
entries.transport: Thin stdio↔Streamable-HTTP proxy to the single closed-source hosted backend mcp.stripe.com — no offline execution mode anywhere in the repo
entries.auth: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY/restricted key (rk_*) as Bearer to mcp.stripe.com; OAuth handled entirely server-side
entries.annotation_coverage: None — structurally impossible, not merely omitted (see Discrepancy: the proxy never constructs a tool object; the one remaining code path calls an SDK overload with no annotations parameter)
entries.sandboxable: Yes — free rk_test_* Restricted API Key scoped to needed resource+permission pairs

inclusion.reason: Meets every population criterion (1,753 GitHub stars at its prior repo name, 16,187 npm downloads/week, listed in Docker Catalog/GitHub MCP Registry/Claude connectors). Requires a caller-supplied STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; also one of the 3 required stateful sandboxes (test mode), so a SandboxManifest template is provided in sandboxes/. Local proxy package is @stripe/mcp (docs.stripe.com/mcp), distinct from the @stripe/agent-toolkit repo this row's popularity evidence was measured against.

entries.name: Figma
entries.popularity_evidence: GLips: 15,690★; npm figma-developer-mcp 73,391 dl/week; PulseMCP: community "Figma Context" 3.4M all-time vs. official "Figma" 111k/week (2.6M all-time); both listed in Docker Catalog + GitHub MCP Registry
entries.transport: community: stdio + HTTP; official: HTTP only (remote or desktop-local), gated by an MCP-client allowlist
entries.auth: community: FIGMA_API_KEY/OAuth token, env var or per-request header; official remote: OAuth only, no documented static-token fallback; official desktop: no credential concept — trust = whichever account the desktop app is logged into
entries.annotation_coverage: community: only 1 of 4 possible annotation keys set per tool (never both readOnlyHint and openWorldHint together, destructiveHint/idempotentHint never used); official: unverifiable (closed-source), and directly contradicts the "figma is read-only" assumption — Figma's own docs describe write tools that "write native Figma content back to the canvas"
entries.sandboxable: community: yes, free PAT; official remote: yes but several tools genuinely mutate; official desktop: not sandboxable headlessly at all

inclusion.reason: Meets every population criterion (15,690 GitHub stars, 73,391 npm downloads/week, listed in Docker Catalog/GitHub MCP Registry). Requires a caller-supplied FIGMA_API_KEY; credential-free discovery not attempted for this entry.

entries.name: PostgreSQL
entries.popularity_evidence: Archived repo ~2,400★ (whole servers-archived repo); crystaldba ~3.2k★; PulseMCP (archived reference) 66.1k/week, 3.5M all-time
entries.auth: None at MCP layer — connection string only
entries.annotation_coverage: archived: none (predates the ToolAnnotations spec — a single query tool, "read-only" only in its description text); crystaldba: partial (title+at most one of readOnlyHint/destructiveHint; never idempotentHint/openWorldHint)
entries.sandboxable: Yes trivially, any scratch Postgres connection string; crystaldba additionally ships a Dockerized test harness

inclusion.reason: Meets every population criterion (archived reference ~2,400 GitHub stars, 66.1k/week PulseMCP, npm package still published). The connection string is a positional CLI argument with no env-var fallback (verified against the saved README), so credential-free discovery is attempted here against a disposable local Postgres container this corpus's own sandbox lifecycle provisions and tears down (sandboxes/lifecycle/postgres-reference.json) -- never a real account's credentials.
